info.title: Elevateo local session and mailbox contract
info.description: Canonical accepted BE-02A lifecycle amendment and unchanged FE-01 read checkpoint. Design contract, not implementation acceptance. All mail content is plaintext. See README.md for normative authorization, lifecycle, byte limits and transport rules.

get.description: Authenticate and check current session revocation before returning actor, organization, context and in-memory CSRF bootstrap token. Does not create or refresh a login. Does not list mailboxes; getMailboxes is the sole capability list. A valid cookie with no currently usable organization returns not_available.

400.description: request_invalid; cursor_invalid for an expired, malformed or scope-mismatched cursor.

401.description: unauthenticated for missing, invalid, expired or revoked session. Clear sensitive client state.

404.description: not_available for absent OR inaccessible object. Identical shape and message; no existence disclosure.

500.description: internal_error; bounded generic message; correlation only, no stack or mail content.

get.description: Visible mailboxes in the current organization only, sorted by immutable id ascending. Read capability is always true for returned objects. All other capabilities are current server-derived hints and do not authorize a mutation.

get.description: Current-authorized conversation in the explicitly selected mailbox; mismatched mailbox and thread is not_available. Messages have independent keyset pagination by sent_at ascending, null first, then id ascending. Cursor binds thread and mailbox plus actor, organization, session context, authorization version, ordering and limit. Empty conversations are valid. Does not mark read.

get.description: Stage the encrypted invite/recovery token hash under a fresh opaque pending-entry cookie for ten minutes. GET performs no verify/password operation. Always redirect to the fixed query-free /auth/complete; no token in HTML or JavaScript.

post.description: Exact Origin plus challenge bound to the pending entry. Claim the entry before POST verify, then set password and verify identity before publishing a local session. Pending entry grants no mail access. Replayed/expired/ambiguous verification fails generically; known password_pending state may retry only password setting, never blindly retry the one-time hash. Clear pending-entry and challenge cookies on completion.

post.description: Exact Origin and challenge bound to the existing opaque session. A locally valid cookie with an expired access JWT may refresh; do not require the ordinary online-read precheck. Commit one durable claim, call Auth once, and CAS publish within the original ten-second request deadline. Contenders return 503 Retry-After 1. Uncertain/expired claim requires reauthentication; never steal/replay it or resurrect after logout. Context and CSRF remain stable. With no selected organization, explicit refresh may select a newly provisioned membership; otherwise keep the local cookie and return 404.

post.description: Exact Origin and current session CSRF or challenge bound to the supplied cookie. Commit local/default or all bound-user local/global revocation and durable upstream intent before Auth. Clear cookie even if Auth is down or access JWT expired. Missing/invalid cookie with valid challenge is idempotent local completion without identity data. Never accept a browser user ID. Clear session and challenge cookies. Global scope requires a locally valid bound user; an expired local session cannot perform global logout and returns 401.

sessionCookie.name: elevateo_session
sessionCookie.description: Rails-managed opaque session; HttpOnly, host-only, Path=/, SameSite=Strict, Secure on HTTPS. No client token persistence.

challengeCookie.name: elevateo_challenge
challengeCookie.description: Five-minute signed HttpOnly challenge; CSRF proof must bind the current session and pending entry when present. Same cookie flags as session.

pendingEntryCookie.name: elevateo_pending
pendingEntryCookie.description: Ten-minute opaque HttpOnly entry handle. Stored encrypted token hash is never sent to JavaScript; pending entry grants no application access.

x-csrf-policy.bootstrap: GET /v1/auth/login-challenge for lifecycle; GET /v1/session after current authentication for ordinary protected mutations.
x-csrf-policy.unsafe_requests: Exact configured Origin plus X-CSRF-Token and the route-specific session/challenge binding; refresh must accept locally valid cookies with expired access JWTs.
x-csrf-policy.sec_fetch_site: defense in depth, not a substitute for token and Origin
